model_annotation:
This figure contains two vertically stacked line plots illustrating training rewards over training steps for two different methods across two difficulty levels of training sets.

Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Steps," which is on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick marks at intervals of 100. The y-axis in both plots is labeled "Training Rewards" and uses a linear scale.

The top plot, titled "Easy Training Set," has a y-axis ranging from 0.0 to 0.4. It contains two lines: a blue line representing "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and a red line representing "Llama-LUFFY-Easy." Both lines start near 0.0 at step 0 and rise steeply during the first approximately 100 steps. The blue line reaches values around 0.25–0.30 by step 100 and continues to increase more gradually, reaching approximately 0.35 by step 200, after which it plateaus and fluctuates between roughly 0.33 and 0.38 through step 500, ending near 0.33. The red line follows a similar early trajectory, rising to around 0.25 by step 100, then continuing upward more steadily than the blue line, reaching approximately 0.35 by step 200 and gradually climbing to around 0.40 by step 500.

The bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set," has a y-axis ranging from approximately 0.0 to 0.2. It also contains two lines: a blue line representing "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" and a red line representing "Llama-LUFFY-Hard." The blue line starts near 0.0 at step 0, rises to approximately 0.08–0.10 by around step 100, and then plateaus, fluctuating between roughly 0.08 and 0.12 for the remainder of the training through step 500. The red line also starts near 0.0 and initially tracks close to the blue line through approximately step 100. It then continues to rise more steadily, reaching approximately 0.15 by step 300 and continuing upward to approximately 0.20 by step 500, with noticeable fluctuations throughout.
